description: Tide predictions (high and low water, metres above MLLW, UTC times) for 1 to 7 days at the NOAA station nearest a point, or at a station id, from NOAA CO-OPS (US public domain). Give lat and lon, or a place name. Coverage is US coasts, Great Lakes and territories only; a point more than 100 km from a station is a 404, not charged. search=name lists stations. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

place.description: Place name, geocoded (instead of lat and lon)

search.description: Name fragment to list stations instead of predictions, at least 3 characters

station.description: NOAA station id, 7 digits, e.g. 8518750 (one of station, place, lat and lon, or search)

name: tides
title: Tides
